checkKinds.symbol: Identifier/pattern must occur at least `min` times within `scope`.
checkKinds.wired: Pattern must occur in at least `minFiles` DISTINCT files. Proves the concept is connected, not merely declared. Closes the Platform Audit Protocol's wiring-gap failure.
checkKinds.forbidden: Pattern must NOT occur in `scope`. Anti-drift gate.
checkKinds.attest: Not mechanically checkable. Requires a dated, evidenced signature in seed/attestations.json.

clauses.title: Creator intent is a first-class object distinct from audio
clauses.quote: SoulSonus translates the human.

clauses.title: Realization carries creator identity, not only a target role
clauses.quote: the interpretive bridge between that internal creative conception and an executable musical production

clauses.title: Non-musical expression is treated as creative information, not raw audio
clauses.quote: interpret those different signals as creative information, not merely as raw audio

clauses.title: BPM is derived by the system, never required from the creator

clauses.title: Key/scale is derived by the system

clauses.title: A complete path exists from untrained input to finished deliverable with zero parameter entry

clauses.title: Vocal mimicry is a named capture modality

clauses.title: One sung performance feeds several processors simultaneously
clauses.quote: SoulSonus should not unnecessarily destroy the multidimensional character of the input. A single performance can feed several processors.

clauses.quote: "Make that transition feel cinematic."
